scmBayesPost 0.4.9
  • Reference
  • Changelog

    Changelog

    scmBayesPost 0.4.9

    • The conditional likelihood (prepare_data_general(likelihood = "conditional")) accepts negative donor weights, as produced by augMultiSynth’s ridge-augmented synthetic control (multiout_synth(augment = "ridge"), augMultiSynth >= 0.3.9). The contrast is linear in the weights, so the gap-series likelihood is unchanged; donors with any nonzero weight are used.
    • build_W_from_augMultiSynth() gains allow_negative (default TRUE for augmented fits).
    • The pseudo-panel likelihood stops with an explanatory error if W has negative weights, since it uses them as regression weights.

    scmBayesPost 0.4.8

    New features

    • prepare_data_general(likelihood = "conditional", L, post): the synthetic-control (gap-series) likelihood, conditional on donor paths and weights. The pseudo-panel likelihood factorises as p(y_j | y_D; beta, sigma^2) p(y_D), and only the first factor involves the parameters. For each treated unit the within-period contrast (1, -w) is applied to the outcome and to every column of the design over event times -L..-1 and post: period effects drop out, the intercept column becomes the unit-effect contrast (set to 1), the treatment column becomes the unit’s own indicator, and covariates enter as treated-minus-synthetic differences. With f.X = y ~ 1 + treatment, OLS on each unit’s rows is the post-minus-pre mean of the gap series, i.e. augMultiSynth’s mean(fit$tau[j, m, post + 1]), and gibbs_postscm() draws are identical to those from the gap series passed in directly. All positive-weight donors are used (including treated units that adopt after the window); a donor treated inside the window is an error. Requires first_stage = "none".

    Behaviour changes

    • likelihood = "pseudo_panel" (the default, unchanged) now warns once per session that donor rows enter as observations and that, without unit and period effects in f.X, tau absorbs the pre-period level gap between a treated unit and its synthetic control. In an augMultiSynth simulation (8 outcomes, 300 treated units) this spec gave RMSE 0.38-0.54 against the true unit effects and 4-9% coverage of 95% intervals, against 0.11-0.12 and 91-95% under the conditional likelihood. Silence with options(scmBayesPost.warn_pseudo_panel = FALSE).
    • Known issue in the pseudo-panel spec, left unchanged for reproducibility: donors that are themselves columns of W are dropped without renormalising the remaining weights.

    scmBayesPost 0.4.6

    Bug fixes

    • Fixed build_iv_formula() losing formula attributes (treatment, instruments, controls) after construction. as.formula() strips custom attributes, causing .parse_iv_formula() to fall back to the unreliable factor() heuristic and misclassify plain numeric controls as instruments. Fixed by using structure() to preserve attributes on the formula object after as.formula() is called.
